annotations.title: Read a Page's DM entry points

description:
[read-only] What a connected Instagram account or Facebook Page (id from list_connected_accounts) shows when someone opens a DM: ice breaker questions, and on Facebook also the greeting, Get Started button and menu links. `config` lists the suggested questions, link kinds and limits.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/accounts/{id}/entry-points.)

brandId.description: An id from GET /api/v2/brands, or "personal". Omitted → the key's bound brand, else the owner's personal accounts.

id.description: An Instagram or Facebook account id from GET /api/v2/accounts.

name: get_dm_entry_points
title: Read a Page's DM entry points
